tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
- The recorded session logs show a full successful flow: navigate to Manage Products grid, close notification overlay, populate multiple grid filters (sku, price/qty ranges, selects for type/attribute-set/visibility/status/website), click Search, and open the Edit page for the SKU WSH12-32-RED-AUTOMATED-02-UPD (product id 2796).

Task Definition:
- Create a reusable, deterministic tool that given an admin base URL and a SKU (plus optional filter criteria) navigates to the product grid, applies filters, extracts the filtered result and opens the product Edit page for that SKU.

Action Plan (ordered steps):
1) Navigate to the Manage Products grid URL derived from {base_url}.
2) Dismiss the notification overlay if present (recorded elementHash used as a deterministic click).  
3) Populate the grid filters (SKU, Price From/To, Qty From/To) and set selects (Type, Attribute Set, Visibility, Status, Website) using header-scoped XPath selectors to ensure uniqueness.  
4) Wait briefly, click the Search / Apply Filters button, wait for the grid to reload.  
5) Extract filtered results (count, SKU list, edit href) for verification.  
6) Click the Edit link scoped to the row with the requested SKU and wait for the Edit page.

Variable Identification (parameters needed):
- base_url (string, required): base admin URL used to form grid URL. Recorded session used http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin.
- sku (string, required): the SKU value to locate and open the product for editing.
- product_type, attribute_set, price_from, price_to, qty_from, qty_to, visibility, status, website (optional strings): optional filter criteria that were used in the recorded run and help narrow the results.

Step Optimization and Rationale:
- Navigation optimized to a single deterministic URL: {base_url}/catalog_product/.
- Overlay close is implemented as a deterministic click by elementHash (df76c6ce85) because it was present in the recording and reliably dismissed the notification that otherwise obscures toolbar controls.
- Filter inputs/selects use header-scoped XPaths (e.g. //th[.//a[normalize-space()='SKU']]//input) rather than positional nth-child selectors to be robust against column reorder or hidden columns.
- Search click uses an XPath that matches common patterns (button or input) to cover both implementations observed in Magento 1/2 variations.
- The Edit link is located using a row-scoped XPath by SKU to avoid ambiguity and ensure the correct product is opened.

Deterministic considerations and limitations:
- The tool assumes the executing browser session is already authenticated to the Magento admin. It does not attempt login (per recorded actions and instructions).
- If JavaScript is disabled in the browser, some grid behaviors (AJAX filter apply, mass actions) might not work. The recorded session showed a JS notice; prefer running with JS enabled.
- Optional inputs are always written into their fields (empty values result in blanking those filters). The automation environment should provide visible text matching select options when selecting dropdowns.
- ElementHash was used only for the overlay close step to provide a recorded deterministic target. Other interactions use header-scoped XPath or attribute-based selectors to maximize reliability across Magento themes/versions.

Result:
- This tool executes the essential, deterministic steps required to locate a product by SKU using grid filters and open its Edit page. It exposes a compact input schema (base_url and sku required) plus optional filters to fine-tune results.
name: magento_admin_find_and_open_product
description: Find products on the Magento Admin Manage Products grid using filter criteria (sku, type, attribute set, price/qty ranges, visibility, status, website) and open the product's Edit page. Assumes the session is already authenticated in the admin UI. The tool navigates to the product grid, dismisses the notification overlay if present, fills filters, applies Search, extracts the filtered result, and opens the product Edit page for the SKU provided.

steps.description: Open the Manage Products grid page in Magento Admin.
Close the 'Incoming Message' / notification overlay if present (click the [close] link). This elementHash targets the overlay close control observed during recording.
Enter the SKU into the SKU filter input in the grid header (column-scoped XPath to avoid collisions).
Enter the lower bound for Price filter (Price From). If empty the input will be left blank.
Enter the upper bound for Price filter (Price To). If empty the input will be left blank.
Enter the lower bound for Qty filter (Qty From). If empty the input will be left blank.
Enter the upper bound for Qty filter (Qty To). If empty the input will be left blank.
Select product Type in the Type column filter by visible text (leave empty to skip).
Select Attribute Set in the corresponding column filter by visible text (leave empty to skip).
Select Visibility filter option by visible text (leave empty to skip).
Select Status filter option by visible text (leave empty to skip).
Select Website filter option by visible text (leave empty to skip).
Give the page a short moment to register the filled filter values before applying Search.
Click the Search / Apply Filters control to apply the grid filters (XPath matches <button> or <input> variations).
Wait for the grid to reload with filtered results.
Capture filtered results so calling code can confirm that the desired SKU was found and retrieve its edit URL.
steps.goal: Extract filtered row count, the SKU(s) present and the Edit link href for the row that matches the SKU provided.

steps.description: Click the Edit link for the row whose SKU equals the provided {sku}. This XPath scopes to the row and finds the 'Edit' anchor.
Wait for the product Edit page to load.

input_schema.name: base_url
input_schema.description: Base admin URL (no trailing path). Example: "http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin". The tool will navigate to {base_url}/catalog_product/.

input_schema.name: sku
input_schema.description: SKU to search for. The tool locates the matching row by SKU and opens its Edit link.

input_schema.name: product_type
input_schema.description: Visible text of the Type filter option, e.g. "Simple Product", "Configurable Product". Leave empty to skip setting this select.

input_schema.name: attribute_set
input_schema.description: Visible text of the Attribute Set filter, e.g. "Default". Leave empty to skip setting this select.

input_schema.name: price_from
input_schema.description: Lower bound for Price filter (numeric string). Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: price_to
input_schema.description: Upper bound for Price filter (numeric string). Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: qty_from
input_schema.description: Lower bound for Qty filter (numeric string). Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: qty_to
input_schema.description: Upper bound for Qty filter (numeric string). Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: visibility
input_schema.description: Visible text for Visibility filter, e.g. "Catalog, Search". Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: status
input_schema.description: Visible text for Status filter, e.g. "Enabled" or "Disabled". Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: website
input_schema.description: Visible text for Website filter, e.g. "Main Website". Leave empty to skip.
